description: Source code for the 'git difftool' builtin command, implementing directory and file diffing with external tools, including configuration parsing, command execution, and handling of symlinks, submodules, and working tree modifications.

classes.name: difftool_options
classes.description: Structure holding options for the difftool command, including symlink handling and exit code trust.

classes.name: working_tree_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the working tree hashmap, containing a path.

classes.name: pair_entry
classes.description: Represents a pair of file paths and associated metadata for directory diffing.

classes.name: path_entry
classes.description: Represents a file path in the hashmap used for tracking changed files.

classes.name: child_process
classes.description: Structure used for executing external commands, with fields for arguments, environment, and execution flags.

methods.name: difftool_config
methods.description: Configures difftool options based on git configuration variables.

methods.name: print_tool_help
methods.description: Prints help information for available diff tools.

methods.name: parse_index_info
methods.description: Parses index information lines from diff output.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Appends a relative path to a strbuf, managing slashes.

methods.name: use_wt_file
methods.description: Determines if a working tree file can be reused based on its object ID.

methods.name: get_symlink
methods.description: Retrieves symlink content either from the filesystem or object database.

methods.name: checkout_path
methods.description: Checks out a specific object ID to a path in the working directory.

methods.name: write_file_in_directory
methods.description: Writes content to a file within a specified directory, creating leading directories as needed.

methods.name: write_standin_files
methods.description: Creates placeholder files for submodules and symlinks for directory diffs.

methods.name: run_dir_diff
methods.description: Performs a directory diff using an external tool, handling submodules, symlinks, and working tree modifications.

methods.name: run_file_diff
methods.description: Runs a file diff using the configured external diff tool.

methods.name: cmd_difftool
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git difftool' command, parsing options, setting environment, and dispatching to directory or file diff routines.
